_about: Every printed mushaf the Qur'an tab can show as pages, and the only place one is named.
Adding one is an entry here plus its file beside this one; no code is written.
id      what the reader's choice is remembered by, and the file's name (<id>.json).
script  which face draws it: the frontend maps it to a font (styles/components.css .mushaf).
source  the sources.json entry that credits it.
The files are built by backend/scripts/build_mushaf.py and read by backend/services/mushaf.py.
